title: journey-qa persona roster
description: A fictitious team. Every value is invented; nothing is derived from real people or real data.

privileged_roles.description: Roles that count as privileged (roster_check --admins, sql_assert kind privileged_handle). Default ["admin"].

id.description: Stable key used by scenarios (persona: ivy).

name.description: Display name. Must be obviously fictitious.

email.description: Product login email. Reserved domain only (example.com/.org/.net or .test/.example/.invalid).

handle.description: OS user name / product user id. Allowed by the HOMEPATH rule.

role.description: Product role, in the product's stored shape (adapter defines allowed values).

persona.description: Behavioural profile used by journeys and the data generator.

accounts.description: Optional extension: external accounts the person uses inside the product. If a person holds external accounts, uniqueness holds per provider: 1:1:1 (person : login_email : account_id).

plan.description: Stored-shape value the product writes, never a display label.

cwd.description: Optional extension: working directory. When present it must live under /home/<owner handle>/ or /Users/<owner handle>/.
